name: communication
title_zh: 所有对外输出先过一遍的通讯守门员
tagline_zh: 写给客户、同事、文档的每句话都被压成最短路径；长内容自动转交写作技能，不让你在聊天框里写小作文。
tagline_en: Every email, doc, or chat reply gets squeezed to its shortest route; long prose auto-routes to the writing skill.
desc_en: Persistent policy for concise user-facing communication and routing durable prose through the writing skill. Use for every response, document, report, engineering message, or human correspondence.
why_zh: 它把「简洁」变成硬策略而非个人风格：每次回复都先裁掉冗余，再决定该走对话还是走正式写作通道。
why_en: It enforces brevity as policy, not preference: each reply is stripped of fluff first, then routed to chat or formal.
limit_zh: 只约束你发给人的文字，不碰代码注释、日志、内部草稿；且它依赖写作技能处理长文，若未安装该技能，长内容只会被截断提示。
limit_en: Only polishes human-facing text; ignores code comments, logs, and internal drafts. Needs the writing skill for long-form; otherwise long content.
title_en: A gatekeeper that trims every outgoing message before it.
